title: Add browser smoke matrix and artifact publication
description:
Problem: critical route smoke coverage (`/memories`, `/pages`, `/chat`, `/tasks`, `/health`) is documented as needed but not enforced by an implementation-quality CI matrix with clear artifacts.

Desired outcome: add a route-smoke browser suite with per-route failure attribution and reliable artifact publication for triage.

Scope:
- In scope: route smoke specs, deterministic selectors/assertions, artifact folder conventions, and CI artifact uploads.
- Out of scope: deep functional scenario coverage unrelated to route rendering/navigation health.

Dependencies:
- Required browser gate foundation from TSK-0067.

Acceptance criteria:
- Browser smoke suite exercises the five core routes under one CI run.
- Failures identify which route assertion failed.
- Artifacts are published and linked from CI summary.

Validation:
- Local run of browser smoke suite with artifact generation.
- CI run verifies upload paths and retention settings.

Rollback:
- Temporarily reduce smoke suite breadth to smallest stable subset while preserving route-hop regression test.
